title: Sarvam AI TTS plugin
note: This is the PR that created the plugin. It ships on npm as @livekit/agents-plugin-sarvam, and without it there is no Sarvam support in the framework at all: 11 Indian languages, 45+ voices, one-shot REST synthesis and WebSocket streaming with sentence tokenisation.

title: Sarvam AI STT plugin
note: Speech to text on the same plugin. 22+ Indian languages, five transcription modes, WebSocket streaming with VAD events and reconnect on idle.

title: Explicit Sarvam WS and REST toggles
note: The streaming and REST paths both existed but you could not choose between them. Now you can, and the default behaviour is unchanged.

title: Added two apps to the showcase
